[[File:Brianna Emery DecipherCon 1999.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Brianna Emery at DecipherCon 1999. Photo: Decipher.]]
'''Brianna Emery''' attended [[DecipherCon 1999]], held 11–14 November 1999 at the Cavalier Hotel in Virginia Beach, Virginia.<ref name="dc99-home">[http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/ DecipherCon 1999], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20020823212712/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/ Internet Archive]</ref> Decipher's Sunday photo set shows her with a camera, taking pictures "for her own collection".<ref name="sun14">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/photos/SUN/sun14.html DecipherCon 1999 Sunday photo sun14], Decipher. Caption: "Brianna Emery snaps a few shots for her own collection." Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000525082135/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/photos/SUN/sun14.html Internet Archive]</ref>
